scope: Nursery update notice and guide only; no fluent review claimed. No lesson or quiz changes.

entries.source: Plan seedlings, trays and nursery space with your own equipment and estimates.

drafts.zu: Hlela izithombo, amathileyi nendawo yenkulisa ngohlelo lwakho lwezitshalo usebenzisa izinto nezilinganiso zakho.
drafts.st: Rala dipeo tse melang, diterei le sebaka sa sebaka sa ho hodisa dimela ho ya ka moralo wa dijalo, o sebedisa thepa le dikgakanyo tsa hao.
drafts.ts: Kunguhata swimilana, tithireyi ni ndhawu ya nesari hi kungu ra wena ra swibyariwa u tirhisa switirhisiwa ni minkanyeto ya wena.
drafts.ve: Pulanani zwiraba, thireyi na tshikhala tsha nesari u bva kha pulane ya zwiliṅwa ni tshi shumisa zwishumiswa na nyelekanyo dzaṋu.

drafts.st: Hlahloba sebaka sa ho hodisa dimela
Moralo wa dijalo → Moralo wa sebaka sa ho hodisa dimela
drafts.ts: Mukungu wa swibyariwa → Mukungu wa nesari
drafts.ve: Mupulani wa zwiliṅwa → Mupulani wa nesari

entries.source: Add your tray sizes, usable nursery surface and crop estimates. Review overlapping demand and missing information before adding automatic sowings.

drafts.zu: Faka osayizi bamathileyi akho, indawo yenkulisa engasetshenziswa nezilinganiso zezitshalo. Hlola izidingo ezihlangana ngesikhathi nolwazi olungekho ngaphambi kokwengeza ukuhlwanyela okuzenzakalelayo.
drafts.st: Kenya boholo ba diterei, sebaka se ka sebediswang ho hodisa dimela le dikgakanyo tsa dijalo. Hlahloba ditlhoko tse kopanang le tlhahisoleseding e haellang pele o eketsa ho jala ho iketsang.
drafts.ts: Nghenisa tisayizi ta tithireyi, ndhawu ya nesari leyi tirhisiwaka ni minkanyeto ya swibyariwa. Kambisisa swilaveko leswi hlanganaka ni vuxokoxoko lowu kayivelaka u nga si engetela ku byala loku kunguhatiwaka hi app.
drafts.ve: Dzhenisani saizi dza thireyi, tshikhala tshi shumiseaho tsha nesari na nyelekanyo dza zwiliṅwa. Ṱolani ṱhoḓea dzi no khou itea nga tshifhinga tshithihi na mafhungo a no khou ṱahela ni sa athu u engedza u zwala ho pulaniwaho nga app.
